focus_areas: Legibility of text on the iPod screen (menu items, song titles).
Sharpness and definition of the Click Wheel buttons (Menu, Play/Pause, etc.).
Boundary integrity between the screen glass and the white plastic casing.
Realism of reflections on the glossy white surface.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the iPod screen. AI often generates plausible-looking but unreadable text. Also, inspect the click wheel's central button; it should have distinct directional labels. If these are blurred or missing, it is a significant artifact. The background is noisy, but the primary subject (iPod) must be structurally sound.
